title: limit_rows: keep only the first N rows
description: Keep only the first N rows of the dataset. Use this to show a sample, take the top-N results after sorting, or cap the output size. Always apply sort_values before limit_rows when the user asks for 'top N by column'.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of rows to keep. Must be a positive integer.

rag_note: limit_rows does not sort — it simply takes the first n rows of the current DataFrame. To get the top-N rows by a column value, use sort_values first, then limit_rows.
